Graduate Program Admission Letter
Dear student,
Congratulations! On behalf of the Graduate Admissions Committee, I am 
pleased to inform you that you have been admitted to the Graduate Program 
at the University of Illinois at Chicago (UIC) for the upcoming term. Your 
academic achievements and potential for success in your chosen field of 
study were evident in your application, and we are confident that you will 
make significant contributions to our academic community.
As an admitted student, you will have access to world-class faculty, state-of-
the-art research facilities, and a vibrant intellectual environment. We 
encourage you to explore the many opportunities available to you and to 
connect with faculty and fellow students in your program.
Please review the enclosed information regarding your admission, including 
important deadlines, enrollment procedures, and financial aid opportunities. 
Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact our office.
We look forward to welcoming you to UIC and wish you every success in 
your graduate studies.
Sincerely,
Graduate Admissions Committee
University of Illinois at Chicago
